##### Project general facts

Woodland Terraces by AMIS is a refined residential building with minimalist facades, generous glazing and panoramic windows that give it an elegant, contemporary presence. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to five residential floors and a rooftop. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom apartments with a study and two- and three-bedroom homes with open-plan layouts and high ceilings, together with retail units at ground level for everyday convenience.

Amenities are designed for a sun-soaked, balanced lifestyle. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, sports amenities and a fully equipped fitness centre, together with steam and sauna rooms and a yoga area. An outdoor theatre, a barbecue area, lounge areas and the AMIS Cafe create relaxed places to gather, while a kids' play area keeps the youngest residents entertained. A grand lobby with a concierge desk, underground parking and round-the-clock security complete the shared facilities.

Every residence features a balcony with views over the surrounding district, along with storage systems, built-in wardrobes and a laundry area. Interiors in soft pastel tones create a cosy, welcoming living space, while open-plan layouts and high ceilings bring in natural light. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, and bathrooms are finished with quality fixtures. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City District Eleven is a green residential neighbourhood within Meydan, known for its lagoons, landscaped parks and calm streets. The Meydan Racecourse, The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Golf are close by, while world-class restaurants, shops and entertainment are within easy reach, creating a balanced setting for families and professionals.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Al Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Hills Mall are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah are within comfortable reach, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the surrounding communities.

Meydan is a freehold area with strong appeal for professionals and families seeking a calm address close to Downtown Dubai. Boutique residential buildings with resort-style amenities attract steady demand from tenants working in the city's main business hubs, supporting attractive rental yields. A central position, green surroundings and an established lifestyle offer underpin long-term value and capital growth for owners and investors.
